### Features

- 🎵 **Reach** — search, play and download music from Deezer and Soulseek
- 🎙️ **Podcasts** — search and download episodes to your Y1 over the internet
- ⚡ **Quick menu** — global context menu for playback, queue, Wi‑Fi, Bluetooth, and more
- 🎨 **Y1 themes** — install and apply themes from the original Y1 firmware
- 🔊 **Rockbox-Y1** — co-installed; switch launchers from Settings (no reboot)

## Assets

- `app-release.apk` — signed Solar launcher
- `rom.zip` — Y1 type A firmware (2.0.0+, MT6572)
- `rom_type_b.zip` — Y1 type B firmware (before 2.0.0, MT6572)

- 888576d Fix SystemUI crash: re-enable UsbStorageActivity on startup
- 5ccf993 Soulseek version interest, diagnostic log sharing, rich release notes, USB fix
- 3fc45b4 Bump stable version for next release.
- 62356a2 Suppress system USB dialog via pm disable, auto-disable Rockbox on startup
- 3c22bf4 Bump stable version for next release.
- 180f1e8 Fix USB dialog suppression: defer hasWindowFocus check to execution time
- 9a260b0 Bump stable version for next release.

# Solar 0.1 (c6c0bbe) — stable

> **Solar** is a custom firmware and launcher for the [Innioasis Y1](https://github.com/y1-community/InnioasisY1Themes) — a full interface replacement with podcast downloads, a global quick menu, **Reach** (Deezer + Soulseek), Y1 theme support, and **Rockbox-Y1** on the same ROM (switch without reboot).

### Features

- 🎵 **Reach** — search, play and download music from Deezer and Soulseek
- 🎙️ **Podcasts** — search and download episodes to your Y1 over the internet
- ⚡ **Quick menu** — global context menu for playback, queue, Wi‑Fi, Bluetooth, and more
- 🎨 **Y1 themes** — install and apply themes from the original Y1 firmware
- 🔊 **Rockbox-Y1** — co-installed; switch launchers from Settings (no reboot)



## Assets

- `app-release.apk` — signed Solar launcher
- `rom.zip` — Y1 type A firmware (2.0.0+, MT6572)
- `rom_type_b.zip` — Y1 type B firmware (before 2.0.0, MT6572)
